tool.name: DrugCLIP Search
tool.description: Search pre-computed virtual screening database (FREE, no GPU)

param.name: uniprot_id
param.label: UniProt ID
param.help: Target protein UniProt ID (e.g., P00533 for EGFR)

param.name: top_k
param.label: Top K compounds
param.help: Number of top-scoring compounds to return

tool.help:
**DrugCLIP: Pre-computed Virtual Screening Database (FREE)**
Access DrugCLIP's pre-computed screening results for 10,000+ human proteins against 500 million compounds. Results available instantly!
**No GPU or local computation required!**
**Database Coverage:** - 10,000+ human protein targets - 500 million compound library - Pre-computed binding scores
**Input:** - UniProt ID of target protein
**Output:** - Top-scoring compounds with SMILES and scores
**For custom proteins not in database**, use the local DrugCLIP tool.
**Citation:** Gao et al. (2026). DrugCLIP: Contrastive learning for virtual screening. Science.
